title: The Great Slow Saturday
skyStory: The moon has wandered into Taurus, more than half full now and moving at the pace of a cow crossing a country road. Taurus loves comfort, texture, warm bread and very soft blankets. It refuses to be rushed and does not understand why anyone would try. Mars taps his watch. Taurus slowly eats a biscuit, staring at Mars the entire time.

reading: After two days of the moon in your sign, the Tiger is ready for a long nap in a patch of sun. Taurus fully supports this. Today, do something slowly on purpose. Simmer a pot of soup from scratch. Sand a piece of wood. Read one page three times because you liked it.

[[The Empress]] lounges across your afternoon in a velvet robe, insisting that pleasure counts as productivity on Saturdays. Around 4 pm the cabin will smell amazing, whatever you are doing. Let someone else serve you the first bowl or cup. Receiving is a skill, and you are getting better at it.
joel.mission: Do one thing today at exactly half your normal speed, from start to finish, and notice what you notice.
joel.omen: Fresh tracks in new snow, leading somewhere you did not expect. It means the slow path is the right one today.

reading: The Wood Rat loves a good hoard, and today Taurus wants you to hoard comfort. Gather your favourite blanket, a stack of books, a warm drink, a window. Build a fortress of softness and refuse to leave it for at least an hour.

Around midday, a memory from a long-ago winter will float up: sledding, maybe, or a snow fort with a tunnel. Tell it to someone, with full hand choreography. The [[Ten of Cups]] is quietly glowing on the shelf, reminding you that the best things in a day rarely come with a price tag.
nancy.mission: Build a blanket fortress and stay inside it for one full hour, snacks and stories permitted.
nancy.omen: A cardinal on a snowy branch. It means warmth is coming toward you this weekend from an unexpected direction.

together.text: Make something warm today, separately, and send a photo of it: soup, cocoa, toast, anything. Describe it in the most dramatic critic language possible. Taurus will award a velvet ribbon to the most poetic review, and Mars will be told to sit down and wait his turn.

game.intro: The Great Slow Saturday. Nobody is rushing. Saturn is still in his robe. Spell us something delicious.
game.prompt: Your perfect slow Saturday breakfast, course by course.
